title: gcp-resource-clusters.json — Discover phase cluster graph
description: Resources grouped into logical migration clusters with a full dependency graph and creation order. Produced by the discover-iac fragment. FLOOR contract (required structure only; additional properties allowed). The clustering ALGORITHM (how resources group, edge typing, topological sort) is the discover-iac prose + references/clustering/, not this schema.

clusters.description: Logical clusters, each an atomic migration unit.

primary_resources.description: GCP resource addresses that map independently.

secondary_resources.description: GCP resource addresses that support the primaries.

network.description: The VPC cluster ID this cluster belongs to, or null if this IS the networking cluster.

creation_order_depth.description: Depth level in the topological sort (0 = foundational).

must_migrate_together.description: Whether the cluster is an atomic deployment unit.

dependencies.description: Other cluster IDs this cluster depends on (from cross-cluster PRIMARY→PRIMARY edges).

edges.description: Typed relationships between resources with structured evidence.

evidence.description: Where the relationship was found: field_path + reference.

creation_order.description: Global cluster ordering by depth level, for migration sequencing.
